exposure: multiple daily injections (MDI) of insulin using nano-hydrogel delivery carrier
continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) using nano-hydrogel delivery carrier
outcome: therapeutic time of blood glucose normalization
cohort: Eighty children diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) at INNER MONGOLIA BAOGANG Hospital between October 2018 and December 2019.
finding: Continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) therapy demonstrated significant advantages in improving blood glucose control, reducing HbA1c levels, and shortening the therapeutic time of blood glucose normalization compared to multiple daily injections (MDI) in children with T1DM.
